title: Length of the iterated output word
statement: For every bit string $x$, let $u$ be the word obtained by applying the specified one-pass binary transducer to $x$, and let $W(x)$ be the word obtained from $u$ by the specified pairing, iteration, and projection construction. Then $|W(x)|=4^{\lfloor\log_4 |u|\rfloor}$.
caveat: The formal statement relies on several upstream constructions whose informal descriptions are unavailable or incomplete in the payload, so the output word can only be identified by that construction.
